title: Drunk Trio Arrested After Violent Bar Fight Over Vending Machine Refund!
description:
On May 3rd, 2024, officers in Ohio responded to a local bar for a disturbance involving a bartender. Officers arrived at the local bar and located the female suspect in a group outside. An officer spoke with the group while another officer spoke to the bartender about what had happened. 

Upon talking to both parties, officers learned a dispute had broken out after the suspect began arguing with the bartender over getting her money back from a vending machine. Despite the bartender explaining she did not operate the vending machine, tensions escalated, leading the suspect to attempt to assault the bartender. 

The suspects were arrested and placed in separate police cruisers for transport to jail. All three suspects were charged with Disorderly Conduct while Intoxicated. Additionally, the 24 and 37-year-old suspects faced charges of Aggravated Assault. The 34-year-old suspect also faced an additional charge of Using Weapons While Intoxicated.
